nodes.name: supervisor
nodes.task: Select a retrieval strategy from request capabilities and actual index readiness

nodes.name: query_understanding
nodes.task: Extract and validate query budget, category, brand, and source-product constraints

nodes.name: customer_context
nodes.task: Analyze real cross-channel shopping history or read the anonymous catalog baseline

nodes.name: product_retrieval
nodes.task: Execute Chroma retrieval or content fallback with attributable product evidence

nodes.name: recommendation
nodes.task: Compute text, preference, category, brand, budget, and availability components

nodes.name: product_ranking
nodes.task: Sort candidates by the actual weighted scores with deterministic tie breakers

nodes.name: availability
nodes.task: Recheck current database stock/facts before selecting the requested number of products

nodes.name: explanation
nodes.task: Render product-specific explanations from actual component scores and evidence IDs

nodes.name: validation
nodes.task: Verify live facts, customer constraints, ranking arithmetic, references, and grounding

nodes.name: response
nodes.task: Render the final answer and atomically save validated recommendations, or report a real failure
